title: A race condition in BuildIndex allows multiple goroutines to concurrently build the same expensive index for the same ke
description: A race condition in BuildIndex allows multiple goroutines to concurrently build the same expensive index for the same key. This is caused by moving the b.cacheMu lock from protecting the entire function to only protecting the final cache assignment.

adjudication.why: The label describes redundant expensive builds, without a new failure scenario. getOrCreateIndex performs its cache check outside BuildIndex in both versions, so the old function-wide lock did not recheck the cache or prevent queued duplicate builds. Do not count this performance-only concern as a correctness miss.

title: Calling s.search.TotalDocs() here may race with concurrent index creation: TotalDocs iterates b.cache without synchroniz
description: Calling s.search.TotalDocs() here may race with concurrent index creation: TotalDocs iterates b.cache without synchronization, and the event watcher goroutine started just above could trigger BuildIndex writes concurrently, potentially causing a concurrent map read/write panic.

adjudication.why: TotalDocs iterates the map without the cache mutex while BuildIndex writes it; a map read/write panic is correctness, not efficiency. The original candidate already reports this root cause.
